synth.notes:
Player moves 6px on lattice; blocked by HUD band (y<8) or wall px in dest box unless box holds plate centre; first input (n==0) no-op.
Wall = plate + line + arm + key; body on plate shifts key/arm rows left of line +6 (door opens); layer-1 boxes crop wall px.
A5 off-spawn toggles ghost mode: record life trail [spawn, start, moves...] with red hud (huds x+4), or clear; player respawns to (14,8).
Step-43 mechanic: ghost shows trail[m] (m = moves since record) and is hidden while on the player; a life starting at spawn puts trail[1] on the player's new cell, so no ghost and wall keeps index 7.
Counter loses 1px on even action count (hidden parity, continuity-gated; stateless 21/44). Unconfirmed: spawn constant, unseen step-0 move in life 1.
